name: Elbtal (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, black, white, black and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Elbtal (a chequy saltire on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Elbtal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Elbtal arms — chequy saltire on yellow
